summary: This Form 8-K reports the issuance of $1.3755 billion aggregate principal amount of Series 2026-A Senior Secured SAC Bonds by Appalachian Power Recovery Funding LLC, a special purpose entity, under an indenture dated May 27, 2026. The bonds were offered pursuant to a prospectus dated May 19, 2026. The filing is a routine current report on a debt securitization, not a special-situation transaction. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is involved. The filing is analogous to a standard shelf takedown of asset-backed securities, with exhibits including the indenture, series supplement, and legal opinions. No risk-arb or special situation angle applies.
